items.quote: The measurements were performed between room temperature and 1500 ◦ C with a heating and cooling rate of 5 ◦ C/min. A purified Ar flow of 2.4 l/h through the measuring chamber was applied. The temperature was measured with Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples and calibrated to the melting temperatures of Al (933.47 K), Ag (1234.93 K), Au (1337.33 K) and Ni (1728.30 K). In the temperature range examined, the overall uncertainty of the temperature measurement was estimated to be ±2 ◦ C.
Chemical analysis and XRD were performed subsequently.
